title: Toyoda Type G Automatic Loom
summary: Sakichi Toyoda completed the Type G automatic loom in 1924, the first loom able to change shuttles without stopping. In 1929 the British firm Platt Brothers paid for the transfer of its patent rights, and the money later helped found Toyota's motor business.

uncertainty.note: Both sources give 1924 as the year of invention/completion.

as_recorded.value: In 1924, Toyoda invented the Type-G Toyoda automatic loom
Invented and perfected by Sakichi Toyoda in 1924
